name: Trolltunga
why: A long day over the high plateau above Ringedalsvatnet to a thin tongue of rock sticking out 700 m above the lake.
book: Free: the Norwegian right to roam (allemannsretten). Paid parking at the trailhead. Parking P2 at Skjeggedal (Mågelitopp P3 shortens it by 4 km, book online). Outside mid-June to mid-September go only with a guide.
water: Streams on the plateau (clean). Carry food for the day.
dangers: Long and remote: rescue calls every summer from people turning back too late.
Weather turns fast: fog, rain and wind even in July. Check yr.no and turn back in fog.
Snow on the plateau until late June.
turnaround: Be at Trolltunga by 14:00 from P2, or turn back.
